gloss: number of cases; count (of incidents, orders)

definitions.gloss: number of cases; number of items; count
definitions.explanation: The count of discrete instances of something — incidents, orders, accidents, complaints, dispatches, etc. Used when {件|けん} (case, matter) is the natural counter for the things being counted, especially in statistics and business reporting.

examples.japanese: {事故|じこ}の{件数|けんすう}が{減|へ}った。
{今月|こんげつ}の{注文件数|ちゅうもんけんすう}を{確認|かくにん}した。
examples.english: I checked this month's order count.

examples.japanese: {救急車|きゅうきゅうしゃ}の{出動件数|しゅつどうけんすう}は{年々|ねんねん}{増加|ぞうか}している。
examples.english: The number of ambulance dispatches is increasing year by year.

notes:
Compound of {件|けん} (case, matter) + {数|すう} (number). Commonly attaches to nouns to form statistical terms like {注文件数|ちゅうもんけんすう} (order count) and {問|と}い{合|あ}わせ{件数|けんすう} (number of inquiries).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {件数|けんすう}が{増|ふ}える / {減|へ}る: the number of cases increases / decreases
- {件数|けんすう}を{集計|しゅうけい}する: to tally the number of cases
- {問|と}い{合|あ}わせ{件数|けんすう}: number of inquiries
- {相談件数|そうだんけんすう}: number of consultations
- {出動件数|しゅつどうけんすう}: number of dispatches

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {回数|かいすう}: number of times — for repeated events ({利用回数|りようかいすう} 'number of uses')
- {数量|すうりょう}: quantity — for amounts of physical goods or stock
- {人数|にんずう}: number of people
